27.text: Another method is that of tying the dead body, dressed for the funeral,

28.text: to the rails of a sledge. The sledge is then placed across two long smooth

29.text: poles lying side by side on the ground, so that the runners can easily slide

30.text: on them. Then the soothsayer asks his questions, and tries to pull the sledge

31.text: along. If the answers are favorable, the sledge will run ahead smoothly: if

32.text: unfavorable, some hitch will prevent it from moving. The principle is evi-
